def: Hugging Face's open-source Python library of model definitions for text, vision, audio and multimodal models, with pretrained-weight loading, Auto classes, pipelines, generation and training utilities.
practice: Version 5, which followed a December 2025 release candidate, dropped TensorFlow and Flax to support only PyTorch and aims to interoperate with engines such as vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp and MLX (as of November 2026).
